In scope: how AKO works when it runs on AKS. Out of scope: Atlas-on-Azure networking in general, Entra federation setup beyond what AKO consumes, KEDA/Dapr, billing, and the MongoDB Enterprise and Community operators. If a CR leaves a field unset and Atlas fills in its default, AKO can enter a reconciliation loop and never reach READY. The documented case is a static instance size in the CR being repeatedly applied to an Atlas deployment that has autoscaling enabled. The documented advice is to define the desired autoscaling behavior explicitly. Specific loop bugs were fixed in specific releases: 2.8.1 (minInstanceSize was not cleared), 2.8.2 (autoscaling compute was disabled while min/max instance sizes were still set), and 2.14.0 (AtlasDeployment with terminationProtectionEnabled: true set in the UI).
